horses.incident_text: A Badel (GLORY CLOUD) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that leaving the 800 Metres he allowed his mount to shift in when not clear of LEGEND STAR, resulting in LEGEND STAR having to be checked.  A Badel was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 17 December 2025 and to expire on Sunday, 21 December 2025 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his good race riding record.  Sent for sampling post-race.

A Badel pleaded guilty to a careless riding charge for causing interference leaving the 800 Metres (see LEGEND STAR).  Sent for sampling post-race. <1/12/2025 Appeal – Jockey Alexis Badel>Jockey Alexis Badel has lodged a notice of appeal against the severity of the penalties imposed by the Racing Stewards on 26 November 2025 for the charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)].The Stewards of the Jockey Club have granted a suspension of the penalties imposed on Jockey Badel pending determination of his appeal.  <15/12/2025 Withdrawal of Appeal – Jockey Alexis Badel> Jockey Alexis Badel has submitted an application to withdraw his appeal against the severity of the penalties imposed by the Racing Stewards on 26 November 2025 to suspend him from riding in races for two charges of careless riding [Rule 100 (1)] when he rode GLORY CLOUD in Race 1 and TACTICAL COMMAND in Race 3 that evening.  The Appeal Panel has approved Jockey Badel’s application and he will serve the original suspensions imposed by the Racing Stewards on 26 November 2025. He will be suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday 17 December 2025 and to expire on Sunday 21 December 2025 (2 Hong Kong racedays), and for another period to commence on Tuesday 23 December 2025 and to expire on Sunday 28 December 2025 (2 Hong Kong racedays).

Near the 500 Metres commenced to race keenly and got its head up when being steadied away from BRILLIANT FIRE.  Approaching the 200 Metres was steadied and shifted to the inside of ALWAYS MY FOLKS to obtain clear running.  Near the 50 Metres made contact with BRILLIANT FIRE due to both runners shifting ground.

horses.short: Must pass veterinary exam before racing again
horses.incident_text: Passing the 1100 Metres became unbalanced when racing tight between BEAUTY FORMULA which shifted out slightly and ALWAYS MY FOLKS which lay in and made contact with JOYFUL TREASURE despite the efforts of its rider.  Near the 900 Metres, when racing keenly, was steadied when racing tight to the inside of ALWAYS MY FOLKS when that runner was crowded by SONIC BOOM (H Bentley) which shifted in.  H Bentley was reprimanded.  Shifted out passing the 500 Metres and was bumped.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its left hind leg.  Before being allowed to race again, JOYFUL TREASURE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Jumped only fairly.  Briefly held up making the Home Turn.  Near the 50 Metres made contact with EVER SMART due to both runners shifting ground.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Lay in passing the 1100 Metres and made contact with JOYFUL TREASURE.  Approaching the 1000 Metres briefly raced tight to the inside of SONIC BOOM before SONIC BOOM was corrected by its rider.  Leaving the 900 Metres was steadied to avoid SONIC BOOM (H Bentley) which shifted in.  H Bentley was reprimanded.  K Teetan stated that after his mount was crowded in the early stages it did not finish the race off in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, ALWAYS MY FOLKS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Jumped awkwardly.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Jumped only fairly.  In the early stages raced keenly and near the 1000 Metres was steadied away from GOLDEN LUCK when racing tight to the inside of NEVER SETTLE.  Near the 250 Metres was steadied to avoid SOMELOVEFROMABOVE which was taken in slightly by FUN ELITE (Apprentice E C W Wong).  Apprentice Wong was advised to exercise more care.  BITS SUPERSTAR was then shifted to the outside of SOMELOVEFROMABOVE to obtain clear running and near the 100 Metres was steadied to avoid FUN ELITE as that runner commenced to give ground.  As a result BITS SUPERSTAR was shifted back to the inside of FUN ELITE where it obtained clear running after the 100 Metres.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Apprentice E C W Wong stated that from a wide barrier he was obliged to make use of his mount in the early stages to lead which resulted in it not being able to finish the race off in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, FUN ELITE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Jumped only fairly, shifted in and made contact with FRANCIS MEYNELL.  Shortly after DASHING MAURISON was steadied when FRANCIS MEYNELL shifted out due to the contact.
No report.

Bumped on jumping.  Raced wide and without cover from the 600 Metres.  H Doyle advised that in the early stages her mount raced keenly when positioned tight to the inside of FRANCIS MEYNELL and as a consequence lost ground near the 950 Metres.  She added that CONSPIRATOR continued to race keenly throughout the middle stages.

Shifted in at the start and made contact with TACTICAL COMMAND.  A Badel (TACTICAL COMMAND) was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that leaving the 900 Metres he allowed his mount to shift in when not clear of FRANCIS MEYNELL, resulting in FRANCIS MEYNELL having to be checked to avoid TACTICAL COMMAND.  A Badel was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Tuesday, 23 December 2025 and to expire on Sunday, 28 December 2025 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his good race riding record.  K Teetan reported that after his mount was bumped at the start he did not push it along in the early stages as the horse has a known respiratory condition.  He said as a result FRANCIS MEYNELL settled back in the field.

After travelling a short distance made contact with NEW POWER when racing tight to the inside of CHARMING STEED.  In the middle stages raced keenly.  Near the 150 Metres was hampered when bumped by ROMAN CROWN which shifted out slightly.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Jumped only fairly, shifted out, made contact with NEW POWER and lost ground.  Near the 300 Metres was shifted to the outside of CHARMING STEED to obtain clear running and made contact with ROMAN CROWN.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Making the first turn near the 1000 Metres was eased to allow FATAL BLOW to cross.  As a result ROMAN CROWN then commenced to race keenly for some distance thereafter.  Bumped near the 300 Metres. Whilst the Stewards were satisfied that the riding of H Doyle, 7th placegetter, over the concluding stages did not affect the horse’s finishing position, she was nonetheless reminded of her obligation to ensure that she fully rides her mounts out to the finish of the race.

He added in the Home Straight ALABAMA SONG responded reasonably well to his riding.

He added when placed under pressure in the Home Straight AMAZING GAZE finished the race off only fairly although it bumped with FORTUNATE SON on a number of occasions when ACE WAR shifted out after the 100 Metres.  Trainer D A Hayes advised the horse had pleased him leading into the race and, in his opinion, as AMAZING GAZE is still relatively inexperienced it may not have appreciated racing tight between ACE WAR and FORTUNATE SON in the Home Straight.
